_help: Guide shown in the dashboard tab 'AI tools'. Researched November 2026 - prices and free plans change often, always check the official site. Edit freely.

tools.name: Seedance 2.5 (ByteDance)
tools.note: Often ranked best for photorealistic clips. Pay per second via APIs (e.g. fal); free daily quota reported - check.

tools.name: Kling (Kuaishou)
tools.note: Strong quality / price. Daily free credits (personal use only on the free plan). Check if Kling 4.0 is out.

tools.name: Veo 3.1 (Google)
tools.note: Top quality, video with sound. Paid - through Google AI plans / Gemini.

tools.name: Hailuo (MiniMax)
tools.note: Good motion, free credits for personal use.

tools.name: Runway
tools.note: Editing tools + generation, popular with creators. Paid plans.

tools.name: Pika
tools.note: Fast, fun effects. New open Pika-H3 models trend on Hugging Face.

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.note: Cinematic camera moves.

tools.name: Sora (OpenAI)
tools.note: Discontinued in 2026 (app closed April, API September).

groups.title: Video - free on your own PC (open models)

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.note: Free app to run the open models below on your PC (NVIDIA GPU recommended).

tools.name: LTX-2.x (Lightricks)
tools.note: Open, video + synchronized audio, day-one ComfyUI support. LTX-2.5 is #1 trending on Hugging Face now.

tools.name: Wan 2.2 (Alibaba)
tools.note: Open (Apache 2.0), mature. Newer Wan 2.5 / 2.6 are closed (online only).

tools.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (Tencent)
tools.note: Open (Tencent licence), can run on ~16 GB GPUs with offloading.

tools.name: Nano Banana (Google Gemini)
tools.note: Reported as the most generous free image generator (daily free images).

tools.name: FLUX (Black Forest Labs)
tools.note: Open models, run locally in ComfyUI; cheap via APIs.

tools.name: Qwen-Image (Alibaba)
tools.note: Open, trending on Hugging Face (Qwen-Image 2.1).

tools.name: Seedream (ByteDance)
tools.note: ByteDance image model, sister of Seedance.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.note: Best when text must be readable in the image (thumbnails!).

tools.name: Leonardo.ai
tools.note: Rich free tier.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.note: Artistic quality, paid only (from about $10/month).

tools.name: Kokoro-82M
tools.note: Tiny open text-to-speech model, runs on any PC.

tools.name: Fish Audio
tools.note: Open voice models (e.g. drama-3, trending).

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.note: Best-known voice / dubbing service, paid with a free tier.

tools.name: Suno
tools.note: AI music / songs.
